note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate, soldier and worker are described, but the worker section is cut off at the end of the slice; measurements are taken from the text; synonymy lists, literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule light reddish brown, fontanelle gland region paler; nasus dark brown, darker near the tip; antennae brown; body pale yellow. Head and abdominal tergites with many minute hairs; head with 2 or 3 longer hairs on each side of vertex and a pair at base of nasus; pronotal margins and body with short hairs; anterior abdominal tergites without longer hairs, posterior ones with a few long hairs; sternites with short and long hairs. Body length 3.40–4.25 mm. Head capsule broadly pyriform (1.45–1.60 mm long including nasus, 0.95–1.03 mm long excluding nasus, 0.90–0.98 mm wide); in lateral view weakly incurved behind nasus, swelling weak. Nasus short, conical (0.50–0.60 mm long, nasus length to head length ratio 0.50–0.60); tip with a tuft of hairs. Antennae 12-segmented; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2; segment 4 nearly as long as segment 3. Mandibles vestigial, each with a spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior lobe darker (0.18–0.20 mm long, 0.43–0.48 mm wide); anterior margin convex with a shallow median notch; posterior margin convex.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to light brown; antennae, labrum, postclypeus and legs cream white; abdomen semitransparent. Head and body moderately hairy.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule light chestnut brown; antennae, labrum, postclypeus, pronotum and legs yellowish brown; abdominal tergites smoky brown, sternites yellowish brown with smoky brown patches laterally. Head and body densely covered with short hairs and some long hairs. Body length 14.50–15.00 mm with wings, 8.50–8.70 mm without wings. Head capsule subquadrate (1.05–1.20 mm long to base of mandibles, 1.30–1.38 mm wide including eyes); median arm of frontal suture blurred, lateral arms indistinct. Fontanelle plate long, V-shaped, white, narrow. Compound eyes subcircular (0.43–0.45 mm maximum diameter, 0.35–0.38 mm minimum diameter), situated about one quarter of the short diameter from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval (0.15–0.18 mm long diameter, 0.13–0.15 mm short diameter), about one third of the short diameter from the compound eye (eye–ocellus distance 0.04–0.05 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 subequal to or slightly longer than segment 2. Postclypeus moderately inflated, far less long than wide; anterior margin straight, posterior margin convex. Pronotum trapezoidal (0.65–0.70 mm long, 1.10–1.13 mm wide); anterior margin weakly notched, middle slightly raised in lateral view, without median notch; posterior margin convex with a distinct median notch. Wings smoky grey, membrane with microscopic hairs and fine non-stellate (3–7-armed) spinules; forewing 12.25–12.60 mm long, hindwing 11.20–11.60 mm long.
